resources.string: Shown while Settai is living on the screen.
Tap = tickle · Double-tap = chat · Long-press = menu. Tap Stop to send it to sleep.
Settai lives in your wallpaper: it roams, climbs your widgets, hides and peeks, naps and wakes up.
Lets Settai read the screen and tap / type / scroll for you, only when you ask it in chat. Every tap and every bit of typing asks Yes/No first.

Settai screen agent (optional).

What it does: when YOU ask (for example “open WhatsApp and find Amma's chat”), Settai reads the buttons and text on the current screen and taps, types, scrolls or presses Back/Home step by step. It shows “Settai is driving” while it works; tap Settai or Stop to take over.

What it never does: act on its own, touch the lock screen, type or tap in password fields, or drive banking / payment / wallet apps (you can add more apps to the block list). Every tap and typed text asks Yes/No in Settai's bubble first, and nothing is sent automatically.

Data: the screen text is used only for your request. With an online brain it is sent to the AI provider you chose in Settai's settings; with the on-device brain it never leaves the phone. Nothing is stored except a short “Recent actions” log on the phone.
